;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**Airstrikes by the [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen|Saudi-led coalition]] destroy the [[Presidential Palace (Yemen)|Presidential Palace]] in [[Sana'a]], [[Yemen]], with at least six killed and 30 injuries reported, coalition officials claim they had targeted high-ranking [[Houthi]] officials. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/residents-strikes-presidential-palace-yemeni-capital-092529011.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[Hamas]] has offered [[Israel]] a longterm ceasefire including prisoner exchanges, in return for reductions to the [[Gaza blockade]], and infrastructural improvement. [https://www.jta.org/2018/05/07/news-opinion/hamas-leaders-gaza-offered-long-term-ceasefire-israel-report-says (The Jewish Telegraphic Agency)]

;Arts and culture
*[[List of highest-grossing films]]
**American superhero film ''[[Avengers: Infinity War]]'' becomes the fastest film to make [[US$]]1 billion worldwide, in just eleven days. [http://bgr.com/2018/05/07/avengers-infinity-war-box-office-billion/ (BGR)]
*Large sections of the old [[Tappan Zee Bridge (1955–2017)|Tappan Zee Bridge]] are to be sunk and used as material to build an artificial reef off the coast of [[Long Island]]. [https://www.mnn.com/green-tech/transportation/blogs/new-yorks-tappan-zee-bridge-recycled-artificial-reef (MNN)]

;Business and economy
*[[Latvia]]n bank [[ABLV Bank|ABLV]] sues the [[European Central Bank]] in the [[Court of Justice of the European Union|Court of Justice]] of the [[European Union]], saying the ECB triggered ABLV's collapse. The bank failed following allegations by the [[United States]] that ABLV was [[money laundering|laundering money]] on behalf of [[North Korea]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-latvia-banking/latvian-bank-takes-ecb-to-court-for-triggering-collapse-idUKKBN1I81HS (Reuters)]
*The [[United States]] [[United States Department of Defense|Department of Defense]] says it has resumed accepting deliveries of [[F-35| F-35 Lightning II]] fighter jets from manufacturer [[Lockheed Martin]] after resolving a dispute over a production error which was leading to corrosion. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lockheed-f35-exclusive/exclusive-lockheed-resumes-f-35-jet-deliveries-to-pentagon-official-idUSKBN1I827Q (Reuters)]
*[[Oliver North]] is announced to be the next president of the [[National Rifle Association]]. [https://home.nra.org/lt-colonel-oliver-north-poised-to-become-nra-president/ (NRA)]
*[[Legality of bitcoin by country or territory|Legal status of cryptocurrency]]
**In a landmark bankruptcy case the Ninth Arbitration Court of Appeal in [[Moscow]] rules [[cryptocurrencies]] are property and demands access to a party's [[Bitcoin]] reserves. [http://bitcoinist.com/russian-court-rules-bitcoin-property/ (Bitcoinist)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**About 35 structures in [[Leilani Estates]] are destroyed during the [[Kīlauea]] eruption in [[Hawaii]]. [http://kfor.com/2018/05/07/35-structures-destroyed-after-hawaiis-volcanic-eruption/ (KFOR-TV)]
*A collision of two trains near [[Aichach]] in [[Germany]] leaves two people dead and at least 14 injured. [http://www.dw.com/en/trains-collide-in-bavaria-two-dead/a-43693631 (DW)]

;International relations
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**The United States imposes sanctions on three Venezuelans and 20 drug entities for trafficking activity. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/u-imposes-sanctions-three-venezuelans-under-drug-kingpin-180504279.html (Yahoo! News)]
**[[Vice President of the United States|United States Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] calls on Venezuela to suspend its presidential election later this month citing corruption concerns. This follows a similar announcement made by the [[European Union]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-05-07/pence-is-said-to-call-on-venezuela-to-suspend-may-20-elections (Bloomberg)]
*[[Israel–Paraguay relations]]
**[[Paraguay]] announces that it will move its embassy in [[Israel]] from [[Tel Aviv]] to [[Jerusalem]] by the end of May. Paraguay is the third country to relocate its embassy to Jerusalem after the [[United States]] and [[Guatemala]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-paraguay/paraguay-to-move-its-embassy-in-israel-to-jerusalem-idUSKBN1I81TX (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Egypt]]
**[[Egypt]]ian chief prosecutor Nabil Sadek refers 555 [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] suspects suspected of 63 terror attacks to a military court, while the Giza Criminal Court in [[Cairo]] sentences nine terrorists to life imprisonment and two others to five years imprisonment each. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/egypt-refers-555-to-military-court-on-terror-related-charges/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict|Terrorism in Israel]]
**The [[Knesset]] approves by 55 votes to 14 a bill designed to confiscate payments made by the [[Palestinian Authority]] to terrorists in [[Israel]]. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/245566 (''Arutz Sheva'')]
*[[Murder of Kim Wall]]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] inventor [[Peter Madsen]] appeals his life sentence for murdering [[Sweden|Swedish]] journalist Kim Wall onboard his homemade submarine. He has not appealed his conviction. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44032334 (BBC)]
*[[Indiana]] accused serial killer [[Shawn Grate]] is convicted of two murders. He has previously confessed to, but not been charged with, two more murders and entered guilty pleas to crimes including rape. [https://www.10tv.com/article/shawn-grate-found-guilty-killing-2-women-ashland-county (10tv)]
*An [[Indonesia]]n court rejects a bid by  [[Islam]]ic group [[Hizb ut-Tahrir]] to overturn its ban in the country. The group was outlawed by presidential decree in 2017 on [[national security]] grounds. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/07/indonesia-jakarta-court-rejects-hizb-ut-tahrir-attempt-to-reverse-ban (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Finland]] says compensation payouts for wrongful convictions and imprisonments have quadrupled in ten years, with three million [[euro]]s paid in 2017 versus 720,000 euros in 2007. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/wrongful_imprisonment_claims_in_finland_quadruple_in_10_years/10194181 (YLE)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Japan]]
**Centrist opposition party [[Democratic Party (Japan, 2016)|Democratic Party]] merges with centre-right [[Party of Hope (Japan)|Party of Hope]], forming the [[Democratic Party for the People]]. Members of both parties that disapproved of the merger choose to either join the [[Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan|Constitutional Democratic Party]], become independents or remain in the Party of Hope. [http://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/AJ201805070046.html (''The Asahi Shimbun'')]
*[[Fourth inauguration of Vladimir Putin]]
**[[Russia]]n President [[Vladimir Putin]] is inaugurated at the [[Grand Kremlin Palace]] in [[Moscow]] for a fourth term as [[President of Russia]] following his victory in March's [[Russian presidential election, 2018|presidential election]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44024184 (BBC)]
*[[Lebanese general election, 2018]]
**In official results, [[Hezbollah]] and allied parties win a slight majority of seats in [[Parliament of Lebanon|Parliament]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-election/hezbollah-allies-gain-in-lebanon-vote-underscoring-iran-sway-idUSKBN1I804D (Reuters)]
*[[2017–18 United States political sexual scandals]], [[Weinstein effect]]
**[[Attorney General of New York]] [[Eric Schneiderman]], whose office sued [[The Weinstein Company]] for sexual harassment and discrimination, resigns amid allegations of violence towards four women during his tenure as Attorney General. [https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/harvey-weinstein-scandal/n-y-attorney-general-schneiderman-accused-violence-toward-women-n872181 (NBC News)]
*[[Italy|Italian]] [[President of Italy|President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] says either fresh elections must be held or a neutral caretaker government installed following the collapse of a third round of talks aiming to form a coalition after March's general election failed to produce a clear winner. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44034610 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Scientists discover that WASP-96b has an [[atmosphere]] that is free of [[clouds]]. [https://m.phys.org/news/2018-05-astronomers-exoplanet-atmosphere-free-clouds.html (Phys.org)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Stanley Cup playoffs]]
**The [[Washington Capitals]] advance to the Eastern Conference Finals for the first time in [[1997–98 Washington Capitals season|20 years]] with a 2–1 win over [[Capitals–Penguins rivalry|arch rival]] [[Pittsburgh Penguins]], winning the series 4–2. [http://www.sportingnews.com/nhl/news/nhl-playoffs-2018-washington-capitals-advance-to-eastern-conference-finals-pittsburgh-penguins-highlights-result-score-overtime-win/1c6fze1im6pzp1j7kz55temgc2 (''Sporting News'')]
